items.title: June 2026 Set to be Fifth Driest-Ever
items.whyInNews: June 2026 is set to be the fifth driest-ever, with a rainfall deficit of over 40% across the country, according to the India Meteorological Department.
items.summary: June 2026 is set to be the fifth driest-ever, with a rainfall deficit of over 40% across the country. The monsoon season, which typically begins in June, has been delayed, leading to water scarcity and drought-like conditions in several parts of the country. The India Meteorological Department has predicted that the monsoon will advance over parts of north India in early July, bringing relief to the affected areas.
